videoTitle: Why Your Honeymoon Might Feel Wrong (Even After 12 Years Together)
videoDescription: That sudden doubt right after the wedding? It's more common than you think—and it doesn't mean you made a mistake. Research shows many newly married women experience unexpected sadness or disconnection post-wedding, especially when family conflict and unmet expectations collide. Learn what's really happening at mindtivate.com
script: You've been told that if you're having doubts on your honeymoon, you married the wrong person. But research shows it's actually about something completely different—and it has to do with what changed the moment you said I do...
Visit mindtivate.com to find the answer.
